items.label: Why did my build time out?
items.detail: Builds stop after 45 minutes. Cache your dependencies, or move long jobs to data-pipeline.

items.label: How do preview deploys work?
items.detail: Every pull request gets its own URL. It updates on each push and is removed when the branch merges.

items.label: Can I roll back a deploy?
items.detail: Yes. Open any earlier deploy of Production and choose Promote; the switch takes a few seconds.
